recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加、脂肪減少，三系造血細胞都增生，巨核細胞數量多、大小不一並呈鬆散群聚，部分核分葉多，這種全骨髓增生（panmyelosis）加上多形性巨核細胞是真性紅血球增多症（PV）增生期的典型切片表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with reduced fat spaces
Trilineage hyperplasia (panmyelosis) with prominent erythroid and granulocytic proliferation
Increased megakaryocytes that are pleomorphic in size, including large forms with hyperlobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes scattered and in loose clusters, often near sinusoids
Bony trabecula at lower right without osteosclerosis; no obvious fibrosis at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power is markedly hypercellular with reduced adipocytes. There is trilineage hyperplasia with prominent erythroid and granulocytic proliferation and increased, pleomorphic megakaryocytes ranging from small to large with hyperlobated nuclei, arranged singly and in loose clusters. The bony trabecula is unremarkable and there is no obvious fibrosis or increase in blasts at this magnification, although a reticulin stain is required to grade fibrosis. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera, proliferative phase.

ddx.vs: ET marrow is normocellular or mildly hypercellular with proliferation of large to giant mature megakaryocytes with staghorn nuclei, lacking erythroid and granulocytic panmyelosis.
Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic predominance with decreased erythropoiesis and tight clusters of bizarre megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei.
Reactive erythrocytosis shows erythroid hyperplasia without megakaryocytic proliferation or pleomorphism and lacks JAK2 mutation.
CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and paratrabecular expansion of immature myeloid cells and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
